title: Unknown user 404 and blank-name rejection
problem: Clients cannot distinguish a missing user from a server error, and create accepts empty names.
userStories: As an API client, I get a 404 problem detail when the user id does not exist.
As an API client, I get a 400 when I create a user with a blank name.

acceptanceCriteria.given: no user is stored for the requested id
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 404 with an RFC 9457 problem detail (type, title, status, detail)

acceptanceCriteria.given: a create request with a blank or whitespace-only name
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 and no user is stored
